messages:
alex: heads-up — starting onboarding for edge-13b on dedicated pool. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/edge-13b/v1/ (sharded). putting the model config in infra/edge-13b/config.yaml.

matt: quick q: tokenizer is byte-level bpe or sentencepiece? saw a weird "<|end|>" token in evals that breaks prompt truncation.

alex: tokenizer is sentencepiece, vocab file at s3://redwood-models/edge-13b/v1/tokenizer.model. the end token should be "</s>" — maybe conversion script munged ids.

jen: CI reported container build failures on deploy: CUDA mismatch. Our base image is cuda:12.3 but Triton wheel needs cuda 12.4. logs: https://ci.internal/builds/9876 (ci-bot posted).

ci-bot: build 9876 — FAILED — runtime error: triton: incompatible CUDA version (expected 12.4, found 12.3). full log: https://ci.internal/builds/9876/log

oliver: that explains kernel selection falling back to slow kernels. two options: pin to cudatoolkit=12.4 in Dockerfile or use triton wheel built for 12.3 (we don't have one). leaning to bumping base to 12.4.

matt: bump + rebuild is fine but note quant kernels need nvcc flags we use for 12.3. CI compile step might need a minor patch in build_flags.sh.

alex: agreed, i'll open a PR to update Dockerfile and build_flags. also seeing config validator warning: "kv_cache: enabled for non-streaming model" in config.yaml — that will break draft caching tests.

jen: thanks. I'll take the validator fix (quick check). can you paste the snippet?

alex: here:
```yaml
model: edge-13b
runtime: triton
kv_cache: true
streaming: false
```
should be kv_cache: false for now or streaming: true.

oliver: FYI, when we flip CUDA to 12.4 we should also update the kernel selection matrix: 
- sm86: use optimized int8 kernels
- fallback: generic fp16 kernel if build fails
I'll add a small probe in runtime to surface which kernel was chosen during startup.

jen: PRs —
- Dockerfile: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4123 (bump cuda->12.4)
- validator: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4124 (kv_cache check)

matt: kicked off canary rebuild after PR merged. console shows one failed unit test around tokenizer special tokens. grabbing logs.

alex: pinging @jen for config PR once tests pass. if tokenizer test needs a conversion fix, I have a small script to re-map end token ids to </s>.

oliver: sounds good. we should schedule a short rollback window for the dedicated pool deploy (30m) in case kernel regressions show up.

jen: acknowledged. I'll add a canary-instances tag and monitor latency. :eyes:

ci-bot: build 9890 — SUCCESS — docker build & unit tests passed. canary deploy queued.

alex: thanks team — I'll follow up with a brief runbook for edge-13b in #eng-runtime once canary is healthy.
